About the Team

The Corporate Development team sits at the intersection of OpenAI’s strategy and the global AI ecosystem. Partnering closely with engineering, product, and business leaders, we analyze markets, technologies, and companies to identify opportunities that accelerate OpenAI’s mission and long-term strategy. Bringing together expertise in strategy, M&A, and integration, the team leads the end-to-end process of sourcing, evaluating, negotiating, and integrating acquisitions and other strategic transactions.

About the Role

The Corporate Development Deal Lead will own high-priority M&A and strategic transaction work from early evaluation through diligence, structuring, negotiation, approval, and close. This person will translate strategic priorities and market insight into actionable deal opportunities, build the business case for transactions, and drive cross-functional alignment with senior stakeholders.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who can combine strategic judgment, financial rigor, founder relationship-building, and crisp execution. The ideal candidate can lead complex transactions, partner well with executive stakeholders, and help build the AI-native systems, tools, and operating practices that allow Corp Dev to scale.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Lead end-to-end execution of corporate development transactions (e.g., acquisitions and strategic investments), including sourcing, diligence, valuation, structuring, negotiation, and closing.

- Track and interpret key trends across AI, technology, and adjacent industries, translating the competitive and startup landscape into clear, high-impact insights for OpenAI’s leadership.

- Proactively source acquisition and other opportunities by building deep relationships across the venture, startup, and incubator ecosystem.

- Partner closely with internal leaders to understand OpenAI’s priorities and use external market intelligence to help shape strategy and identify where inorganic moves can accelerate it.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, GTM, and executive leadership to evaluate and advance deals.

- Build financial models, commercial cases, and decision-making frameworks for executive stakeholders.

- Prepare and present deal materials to senior leaders.

- Lead and innovate how we use AI to enhance Corp Dev processes and systems.

- Partner with Integration & cross-functional peers to develop deal goals / metrics and integration plans to achieve and measure outcomes.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 12+ years of experience leading M&A or strategic transactions from start to finish - in corporate development, private equity, investment banking, venture investing, and/or product.

- Deep experience analyzing emerging technologies and markets, and enjoy working directly with founders, investors, and operators. Sector and deal expertise in enterprise / B2B highly preferred.

- A genuine passion for AI and its impact on the world.

- Strong analytical skills combined with commercial judgment and strategic insight.

- Comfort managing ambiguity, building process in a fast-moving environment, and operating with high ownership.

- Clear and persuasive communication skills to influence internal and external stakeholders.

- Excitement to help build and shape the Corp Dev function at a mission-driven AI company.

We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

The successful candidate will lead daily P&L validation, exposure reporting, pricing and curve governance, valuation controls, and risk oversight while partnering closely with Trading, Market Risk, Finance, Operations, Credit, Legal, and Technology teams.

This is a highly visible role offering direct exposure to senior leadership, commercial decision-making, commodity markets, and the end-to-end trading lifecycle.

Daily P&L, Valuation & Exposure Oversight

• Own the daily production, validation, and analysis of trading P&L.
• Provide independent review and challenge of P&L attribution and key valuation drivers.
• Investigate and reduce unexplained P&L through robust analysis and control monitoring.
• Partner with Front Office teams to understand trading strategies, positions, and market exposures.
• Validate exposure reporting and ensure trading activity is accurately reflected in risk and financial reporting.
• Identify, investigate, and escalate control exceptions, valuation issues, and exposure breaches.

Pricing & Curve Governance

• Lead daily pricing and forward curve validation across physical and financial commodity markets.
• Manage curve construction, validation, and maintenance across relevant products and benchmarks.
• Ensure pricing inputs are derived from approved and independently verifiable market sources.
• Investigate pricing anomalies, stale market data, curve movements, and valuation impacts.
• Support risk, valuation, and reporting processes through robust market data governance.
• Partner with Enverus and internal technology teams on enhancements and issue resolution.

Risk Control & Governance

• Maintain ownership of key controls across valuation, market data, positions, exposures, and P&L.
• Develop meaningful exception reporting and management dashboards.
• Identify control weaknesses and drive sustainable improvements.
• Ensure control evidence and documentation meet internal, external audit, and regulatory requirements.
• Promote a strong risk and control culture across the organization.

Month-End & Audit Support

• Support month-end valuation and commercial-to-accounting reconciliations.
• Partner with Accounting to investigate and resolve reporting breaks.
• Support internal and external audit requests, control testing, and process reviews.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and enhanced controls.
• Reduce manual processes and increase transparency across reporting and valuation workflows.
• Support ETRM enhancements, testing, implementation, and system upgrades.
• Participate in strategic projects, new product onboarding, and business expansion initiatives.

What We're Looking For

• Strong experience within Product Control, Market Risk, Trading Risk, Risk Control, Valuation Control, or Commodities Finance.
• Deep understanding of physical and financial energy markets, including oil and refined products.
• Experience with mark-to-market valuation, P&L attribution, exposure reporting, and pricing methodologies.
• Strong understanding of the front-to-back trade lifecycle.
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to challenge constructively and influence across Trading, Risk, Finance, and Operations teams.
• Experience working with ETRM platforms and market data processes is highly desirable.
• Strong Excel skills, Power BI, and SQL knowledge highly desirable.

Why Join World Fuel?

This is an opportunity to play a critical role in a global energy trading organization while working at the center of commercial decision-making. You'll gain exposure across supply, trading, risk, finance, and technology while helping shape the control environment supporting an evolving and growing trading business.

Job Description

The Vehicle Experiences Engine at GM is transforming how millions of people interact with their vehicles by building the software engines behind next-generation digital experiences. At the core of this transformation is the Compute Systems Software team — the group that delivers the foundational embedded platform for GM’s software-defined vehicles.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Compute Systems Software, you will lead the design, development, integration, and debugging of the embedded Linux platform that powers GM’s in-vehicle compute systems. You will work deeply across the Linux kernel, board support packages (BSPs), device drivers, boot and recovery paths, build systems, and core platform services on modern ARM-based SoCs.

You will help ensure that platform software is not only functional in the lab, but performant, diagnosable, recoverable, and maintainable across production vehicle programs.

You’ll report to the Software Engineering Manager, Compute Systems Software, and collaborate closely with partners across Android Automotive OS, multimedia, connectivity, systems frameworks, safety, validation, and vehicle programs. You will also work directly with our silicon vendors to bring up new platforms, resolve complex issues, and optimize platform capabilities for GM-specific use cases.

About the Role

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on embedded Linux and automotive compute. You will influence architecture and engineering practices across the platform while remaining close to the code, hardware, tools, and failure modes that determine real-world system behavior.
You will:

• Own critical pieces of the compute platform, from kernel configuration and BSP integration to device drivers, boot and recovery, and low-level system services.
• Build and maintain Yocto-based embedded Linux distributions and the pipelines that produce production images for multiple vehicle programs and hardware variants.
• Harden boot, recovery, watchdog, and health-monitoring paths to improve platform robustness across hardware and software failure modes.
• Lead complex debugging and root-cause analysis across hardware, bootloaders, kernel, drivers, middleware, user space, build infrastructure, and vehicle integration.
• Automate repetitive engineering work with shell, Python, CI/CD tooling, developer-facing utilities and AI to improve the speed and consistency of diagnosis and delivery.
• Partner with our silicon vendors to bring up new SoCs, integrate vendor deliverables, debug issues, and improve the quality and maintainability of upstream and downstream platform code.
• Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design and code reviews, mentoring, cross-team debugging, and platform-wide engineering standards.

This role is hybrid, with regular onsite collaboration at a GM technical center, consistent with GM’s hybrid work guidelines for engineering roles.

Responsibilities

Embedded Linux platform development

• Design, implement, and maintain Linux kernel modules, device drivers, BSP components, bootloader optimizations, device-tree configurations, and low-level system services for in-vehicle compute platforms.
• Analyze system behavior across kernel and user space, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, diagnosability, and long-term maintainability.

Yocto, build, and release systems

• Configure and extend Yocto-based embedded Linux distributions, including layers, recipes, machine configuration, image generation, and dependency management.
• Own and refine build systems to produce deterministic, reproducible, scalable images across multiple programs, boards, and software variants.
• Improve build and release pipelines through automation, caching, failure isolation, actionable diagnostics, and clear ownership of pipeline health.
• Partner with CI/CD and validation teams to ensure that platform changes are continuously tested and regression-resistant.

Performance, optimization, and debugging

• Profile and optimize CPU, memory, I/O, boot-time, power, and thermal behavior across the embedded stack.
• Use low-level tools such as perf, ftrace, gdb, strace, kernel tracing, crash analysis, and custom instrumentation to diagnose issues spanning software and hardware boundaries.
• Lead root-cause analysis rather than symptom mitigation, distinguishing transient failures, systemic defects, integration problems, and hardware or vendor issues.
• Turn difficult-to-reproduce failures into deterministic tests, better diagnostics, or automated detection wherever possible.

Engineering systems and quality

• Contribute to automated testing and validation strategies for platform software, including unit, integration, boot, stress, fault-injection, hardware-in-the-loop, and regression testing as appropriate.
• Improve developer experience through self-service tooling, fast feedback loops, clear ownership, and well-documented platform workflows.
• Use Git / GitHub and high-quality code review practices to maintain code quality, traceability, and disciplined change management across a multi-team environment.
• Contribute to upstreaming and long-term reduction of downstream patches where practical.

Technical leadership and collaboration

• Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, hands-on pairing, and structured debugging.
• Influence architecture and execution across Android Automotive OS, multimedia, connectivity, safety, systems, validation, and vehicle integration teams.
• Communicate complex system behavior clearly to technical and non-technical partners, especially during high-severity issues and cross-team decisions.
• Drive alignment on priorities, reliability risks, engineering standards, and ownership boundaries.

Vendor and cross-company partnership

• Work directly with our silicon vendors to integrate BSPs and platform deliverables, resolve defects, and improve vendor engagement and issue turnaround.
• Evaluate vendor code and recommendations critically, balancing time-to-integration with maintainability, performance, reliability, security, and upstream alignment.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.
• 10+ years of professional experience in embedded systems, kernel-level, or platform software development, including delivery of production software in automotive or similarly complex embedded domains.
• Deep expertise with embedded Linux on ARM-based SoCs, including several of the following:

• Linux kernel subsystems, kernel configuration, scheduling, memory, storage, networking, power, or low-level system behavior.
• Device-driver development, debugging, and hardware interaction.
• BSP integration, bootloaders, board bring-up, device-tree configuration, and peripheral enablement.
• Hardware abstraction and enablement for new boards, peripherals, and SoC platforms.

• Strong hands-on experience with Yocto or a comparable embedded Linux build system, with a track record of shipping commercial embedded Linux deployments.
• Demonstrated strength in system performance, optimization, and complex debugging, with the ability to lead root-cause analysis across hardware, kernel, drivers, middleware, and user space.
• Exposure to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or production engineering practices, including observability, automation, incident response, and systematic post-incident improvement, applied to complex software platforms.
• Strong experience with build systems and development tooling, including Make-based build flows, Git / GitHub, code review, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release-quality engineering.
• Strong proficiency in C, plus practical experience with Python and shell scripting such as Bash for automation, tooling, diagnostics, and debugging.
• Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture direction, mentoring, design and code reviews, cross-team debugging, and driving execution across organizational boundaries.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions, align partner teams, and explain complex system-level topics clearly.
• Experience working directly with silicon vendors or strategic platform partners to integrate deliverables, resolve issues, and optimize platform capabilities.

Desired Skills

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• Experience contributing to or upstreaming changes in the Linux kernel or related open-source projects.
• Familiarity with Android Automotive OS, HAL integration, and multimedia pipelines such as audio, video, camera, and graphics.
• Experience with crash analysis, platform diagnostics, telemetry, fault injection, or resilience testing.
• Exposure to automotive safety concepts such as ISO 26262, ASIL, safety islands, watchdog architectures, and health monitoring frameworks.
• Experience with secure boot, trusted execution environments, over-the-air updates, rollback, A/B partitions, or production recovery strategies.
• Deep comfort working in Linux / UNIX command-line environments and using classic tools such as shell, core utilities, gdb, perf, strace, and kernel tracing.
• Demonstrated technical leadership in mentoring peers, leading cross-team debugging efforts, and driving platform-wide improvements in reliability, performance, and developer experience.

Production Planning Analyst III is responsible for developing and managing finite production schedules to support efficient manufacturing operations within CPS Korea. Finite Scheduling & Production Coordination

Develop and manage finite production schedules using APS (Advanced Planning System), considering labor availability, machine capacity, raw material supply, maintenance schedules, and holidays.

Analyze and review master production plans for dry and liquid production processes to ensure operational feasibility and efficiency.

•

Monitor daily production execution and ensure adherence to planned schedules.

•

Coordinate with Planning, Production, Warehouse, Procurement, and related departments to ensure smooth production operations.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
